name: 52 Pick-up
description: 52 Pick-up is a social prank using a standard 52-card pack. One player offers a game, scatters all the cards over the floor, and the other player is expected to pick them up. The source explicitly notes that it is not really a card game, so this record treats it as a social card-game joke rather than a competitive rules engine target.

52 Pick-up is a long-standing English-language practical joke played with a standard deck. Reports place the prank before the 1974 novel titled 52 Pick-Up, including memories from the 1940s and later family play.
Two people: the prankster who proposes the game and the target who accepts.
A clear floor or table area where scattered cards can be recovered safely.
There is no real deal. The prankster scatters the whole pack after the target agrees to play.
